Mary & Adelaide.bio: Mary & Adelaide are an Oshawa, Ontario indie-rock band formed in 2017. The group performed at the Robert McLaughlin Gallery's RMG Fridays in 2022 and released the album Celebrate Another Day of Living in January 2026.
